title: CDTP: A LARGE-SCALE CHINESE DATA-TEXT PAIR DATASET FOR COMPREHENSIVE EVALUATION OF CHINESE LLMS
reasoning: The paper focuses on building a dataset and benchmark for evaluating Chinese LLMs on factual knowledge-driven tasks across four domains: History and Politics, Humanities and Society, Technology and Economics, and Nature and Environment. It does not contain any evaluation or benchmark component related to religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
